items.name: chat
items.title: Chat
items.description: A working chat on a simulated host: transcript, streaming reply, tool rows, suggestions, stop and retry. Swap the host for your server or the AI SDK.
items.author: Stack Unseen

items.name: chat-ai-sdk
items.title: Chat on the Vercel AI SDK
items.description: Chat wired to useChat, with tool approvals as approval cards, Markdown replies and a Next.js route whose example tool waits for a person.
items.docs: Set your model and provider key in app/api/chat/route.ts (move it under src/app if your app lives there), then render <Assistant />. Guide: https://unseenui.com/patterns/ai-sdk-chat/
items.author: Stack Unseen

items.name: theme
items.title: Theme
items.description: A scoped theme provider with the base stylesheet: wrap your app or a section in <UnseenTheme>.
items.docs: Wrap your app in <UnseenTheme> from components/unseen-theme. Customize: https://unseenui.com/customize/
items.author: Stack Unseen
